def slugify(text):
    """Convert the input string to a URL-friendly slug."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise TypeError("text must be a str")
    # Lowercase
    lowered = text.lower()
    # Replace any sequence of non-alnum chars with a single hyphen
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', lowered)
    # Remove leading/trailing hyphens
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    return slug

from slugkit.core import slugify

# Test cases from acceptance criteria
tests = [
    ("Hello--World", "hello-world"),
    ("a -- b", "a-b"),
    ("one , two ; three", "one-two-three"),
    ("x___y", "x-y"),
    ("end!", "end"),
    ("  padded  ", "padded"),
    ("--both--", "both"),
    ("(parens)", "parens"),
    ("", ""),
    ("!!!", ""),
    ("   ", ""),
    ("Hello World", "hello-world"),
    ("already-a-slug", "already-a-slug"),
    ("Python 3", "python-3"),
    ("MiXeD CaSe 42", "mixed-case-42"),
    ("caf\u00e9 cr\u00e8me", "caf-cr-me"),
    ("\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e", ""),
]

all_pass = True
for inp, expected in tests:
    out = slugify(inp)
    if out != expected:
        print(f"FAIL: slugify({repr(inp)}) = {repr(out)} expected {repr(expected)}")
        all_pass = False

# Test error cases
for bad_input in [None, 3, 2.5, ['a'], b'bytes']:
    try:
        slugify(bad_input)
        print(f"FAIL: slugify({repr(bad_input)}) did not raise TypeError")
        all_pass = False
    except TypeError:
        pass
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL: slugify({repr(bad_input)}) raised {type(e).__name__} instead of TypeError")
        all_pass = False

# Test that result is always a string
for inp in ['', 'a', '!!']:
    out = slugify(inp)
    if not isinstance(out, str):
        print(f"FAIL: slugify({repr(inp)}) returned {type(out)} not str")
        all_pass = False

if all_pass:
    print("All acceptance criteria tests passed.")
else:
    print("Some tests failed.")
